supersession_reason: Hub review rejected the prior digest because it named an install-style Edge path and did not bind the dirty-tree source content to a fresh binary receipt. This revision corrects both defects and records the coordinator's empty-baseline versus submit-once authority boundary.
purpose: Define one fresh, source-bound Apple-silicon macOS Edge-core to Hub durable-forwarding run. This document gives Hub the exact executable, configuration shape, custody boundaries, zero-state gate, one-event contract and cleanup order without creating runtime inputs or authorizing a process or event.

authorization_boundary.current_authorized_action: Edge may publish this proposal to Hub and the coordinator and update its local planning evidence.
not_authorized: create or read a bearer, certificate, private key, synthetic identity or vehicle credential
create or mutate a guest, runtime root, config, state directory, spool or fixture
install a package, load a LaunchAgent, start Edge or the receiver, or bind a listener
invoke the synthetic producer or submit any event
reuse any historical root, listener, identity, invitation, bearer, certificate or retained state
required_before_runtime: Hub acceptance of this exact proposal and a complete fresh private runtime handoff
Fresh target preflight and redacted path/mode/UID/readability/cleanup receipt before Hub prepares the bounded empty baseline
required_before_producer_event: After the empty baseline and readiness review, the coordinator must separately authorize exactly one producer submission; no event authorization is granted by this proposal.

scope.active_target: supported Apple-silicon macOS, preferably the existing macos13-arm64 target after a fresh preflight
scope.target_os_required: macOS 13.7.4 or the currently supported Apple-silicon target recorded by Hub at handoff time
scope.viewer: excluded from active development, this contract and acceptance dependencies
deferred: named-source TeslaMate parity and passive provenance

source_binding.working_tree_rule: The checkout is dirty. The source head and listed critical-file hashes are the review boundary; Hub must record the exact build manifest and included working-tree content before staging any executable. No commit, branch, package install or publication is authorized by this proposal.

receiver_overlay.source_rule: The dispatcher endpoint and bearer environment are fixed by the pinned source overlay; they are not receiver JSON keys.

source_binding.source_to_binary_rule: The exact current-source darwin-arm64 Edge build is bound by teslatlas-edge/docs/development/edge-macos-arm64-source-binary-receipt-2026-09-12-r1.json, SHA-256 2344d42e1d43199eca57263aae50e7ffa7f68abdd85c7d7fb37d234f26202e5f. That receipt lists the complete Cargo/Rust compilation manifest, dirty-tree status digest, exact command/toolchain, output hash/type/loader metadata and lock acquisition/release. Hub must recheck the receipt and output hash before staging; no package installation is part of this contract.

edge_core.candidate_binary_type: Mach-O 64-bit executable arm64; MH_EXECUTE; macOS minimum 11.0; SDK 27.0
edge_core.recorded_provenance: Fresh Rust 1.98.0 darwin-arm64 build from the exact reviewed dirty-tree manifest under the shared heavy-build lock. No package was installed and no runtime was started.

receiver.build_identity: Go 1.27.0 darwin/arm64, CGO_ENABLED=0, macOS minos 13.0, SDK 26.2, system libraries only
receiver.reuse_rule: The bytes may be selected only after Hub rechecks this hash in the fresh handoff; the retained readiness root and its runtime inputs are evidence, not reusable state.

producer_helper.status: Prior producer candidate evidence only; Hub must recheck the exact helper bytes and bind them in the fresh private handoff. No invocation is authorized by this proposal.

target_binding.os_and_architecture: Hub must record the fresh macOS version/build and arm64 result; the prior receiver receipt was macOS 13.7.4 build 22H420 and is not a substitute for the new preflight.

requirements: new versioned root, owner admin uid 501, mode 0700, no symlink
not /Users/Shared/TeslatlasEdge and not any historical forwarding or receiver root
root and every child retained as non-reusable evidence after cleanup

hub_facing_address.provided_by: Hub fresh guest preflight and bound in the private handoff
requirements: one exact non-loopback private guest address reachable by the Hub fixture
one exact free TCP port for Edge hub delivery
the address must be an IP literal accepted by EdgeConfig; wildcard, loopback and ambiguous hostnames are forbidden
the prior 192.168.64.10 observation from the 2026-09-09 proposal is historical and must not be reused without a new preflight

target_binding.fresh_preflight_required: Hub must prove all four bindings are free or owned only by this newly created run before launch. Any wildcard, occupied, inherited or ambiguous listener stops the run.

path_and_mode_rules.directories: Every fresh root/state/input directory is a non-symlink owned by the process owner and mode 0700.
path_and_mode_rules.private_files: Bearer, spool key, credential store and private keys are regular non-symlink files with owner-only mode 0600; certificates and config are regular non-symlink files and their exact mode is recorded.
path_and_mode_rules.readability: Record exact process UID and path/mode readability for each process without printing secret or payload bytes.
path_and_mode_rules.spool_key: Exactly 32 fresh bytes; no retained key or retained spool may be used.
path_and_mode_rules.receiver_bearer: Fresh printable receiver bearer loaded by both Edge admission and the pinned receiver through the exact environment path; value is withheld.
path_and_mode_rules.hub_bearer: Fresh enrollment-shaped bearer tte1.<credential-id>.<secret>, delivered once to Hub, stored by Edge only as its domain-separated digest; value is withheld.

edge_to_hub.transport: TLS with mutual client authentication plus Authorization: Bearer on every v2 pull and ACK request
edge_to_hub.edge_server: Fresh server certificate/key at the exact hub_tls_paths; certificate SAN must contain the selected private guest IP and key correspondence must be checked without exposing the key.
edge_to_hub.hub_client: Fresh Hub client leaf/key issued by the dedicated hub-client CA accepted by Edge; issuer, SAN/profile and key correspondence must be recorded in a redacted receipt.
edge_to_hub.hub_client_ca: Dedicated CA for this one Hub installation; no shared organizational CA.
edge_to_hub.delivery_bearer: Fresh enrollment-shaped bearer bound only to this Hub installation and this run; no value is recorded in this proposal.

receiver_to_edge.transport: Pinned receiver dispatcher posts HTTP to http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/internal/fleet-telemetry.
receiver_to_edge.bearer_value: Fresh runtime value pending Hub preparation; never record or echo it.
receiver_to_edge.scope: Only the receiver process may use this local admission path; no external ingress.

producer_to_receiver.transport: wss://127.0.0.1:21444/ with the fresh producer client leaf/key and receiver server CA from the private Hub handoff.
producer_to_receiver.identity_requirements: The receiver must accept exactly the fresh client leaf/profile supplied for this run; wrong issuer, missing identity metadata, SAN or key mismatch is a pre-submit failure.
producer_to_receiver.secret_boundary: All certificate/key values are fresh Hub-owned inputs, withheld from this proposal and absent from logs.

identity_binding.source_id: Fresh private Hub handoff value pending
identity_binding.vehicle_id: Fresh private Hub handoff value pending
identity_binding.vin: Fresh private Hub handoff value pending
identity_binding.car_id: Fresh private Hub handoff value pending
identity_binding.installation_id: Fresh private Hub handoff value pending
identity_binding.lineage: Fresh private Hub handoff value pending
identity_binding.distinctness: Hub must prove these values are new for this run and are not any historical r12/r13, receiver-readiness or retained-root identity. The values are not duplicated in this public proposal.

producer_binding.authorization: The coordinator must authorize this exact one-shot invocation after Hub and Edge record the same fresh contract and empty baseline.

record.payload: Exactly one VehicleName-only synthetic datum; no numeric telemetry, units, account credential, vehicle command or passive-vehicle field.
record.expected_receiver_result: One receiver ACK for the fresh identity and one Edge admission; duplicate transport retries, if observed by the receiver, must not create a second logical record.
record.expected_hub_projection: Exactly one fresh VehicleName projection and no unexplained numeric, lifecycle or passive-source projection.
record.sequence_rule: Hub must classify every v2 spool sequence and gap. This minimal run expects one record sequence, no gap notice, one durable commit and one ACK-frontier advance.

zero_state_gate.fresh_root: Before staging, Hub records absent-before-create, owner/mode, no symlink and no retained files under the exact fresh root.
zero_state_gate.edge_initialization: After the config and fresh input paths are bound, the Edge init/doctor result must show a valid fresh 32-byte spool key, receiver bearer, empty credential store, valid TLS and no pre-existing spool records. The command and result are recorded; no secret values are printed.

edge_endpoints.required: Both remain successful for at least five seconds with status ok/ready, records=0, bytes=0, corrupt_records=0, expired_records=0, pending_gap_notices=0 and capacity_exhausted=false.

zero_state_gate.receiver_endpoint: GET http://127.0.0.1:21445/status must return HTTP 200 with body ok, and only the exact receiver process may own 127.0.0.1:21444 and 127.0.0.1:21445.
zero_state_gate.hub_control_poll: Using the fresh mTLS client and bearer, Hub pulls the exact Edge v2 endpoint before any producer invocation. The response must be HTTP 200 with records=[] and gaps=[], and the Hub ledger, pending queue, accumulator and ACK frontier must all be empty or null as defined by the Hub handoff.
zero_state_gate.failure_rule: Any unknown, non-empty, mismatched, inherited or untrusted zero-state field stops the run before the producer is invoked.

durable_forwarding_acceptance.pull: Hub pulls GET /v2/hub/batches/next over the fresh Edge listener with mTLS and bearer; the batch is bounded and the merged record/gap order is preserved.
commit: persist the stable record ID and retained v1 alias in the durable receipt table
deduplicate by stable record ID, not txid, arrival order, VIN/timestamp or memory
apply the one VehicleName-only datum to the Hub ingestion state
commit the receipt and resulting state before acknowledging Edge
durable_forwarding_acceptance.ack: Hub posts POST /v2/hub/acks only after durable commit and records the exact acknowledged record ID, gap IDs and resulting frontier.
durable_forwarding_acceptance.post_ack: A fresh v2 pull returns no pending record or gap; Edge readiness remains healthy and the pending spool record count/bytes return to zero.
durable_forwarding_acceptance.retry_observation: A bounded duplicate pull before ACK may be used to prove stable batch identity, but it must not cause a second Hub projection. No producer retry or replay is allowed.
durable_forwarding_acceptance.protocol_reference: teslatlas-edge/docs/hub-delivery-contract.md and the pinned edge-delivery-v2@2.0.0 source-neutral bundle remain the wire contract.

action_sequence: Hub reviews this exact source-bound proposal and returns a fresh private runtime handoff with root, guest address/port, exact candidate revalidation, config/TLS/bearer paths, process UIDs and redacted identity bindings.

Hub performs the absent-before-create target/root/listener preflight and stages only the fresh versioned run root; historical roots, /Users/Shared/TeslatlasEdge, LaunchAgents and prior credentials remain untouched.

Hub binds the exact Edge config, receiver JSON, Edge artifact and current c2ace receiver bytes, then records path/mode/hash/readability checks. No runtime-generated secret or private value is copied into this proposal.

Hub runs the bounded Edge init/doctor and receiver/Edge empty baseline, verifies health, readiness, receiver status, listener ownership and the trusted empty Hub poll, and sends the evidence to the coordinator.
Only after the coordinator separately authorizes one submission may Hub invoke the exact fresh producer helper once with the fresh synthetic identity and receiver mTLS inputs.
Hub drains the one admitted record through durable commit and v2 ACK, records sequence disposition, projection count, ACK frontier and post-ACK zero state, and does not retry the producer.
Hub performs the bounded cleanup order and retains only redacted, versioned, non-reusable evidence roots and receipts.

cleanup_and_timeout.timeout_rule: On timeout or ambiguity, record the exact boundary, do not retry or replay the producer, and stop only processes owned by this fresh run.
stop_order: Hub records its durable commit/timeout result and stops only the fresh Hub fixture.
Hub stops the receiver and records the exact PID, UID, signal/exit result and listener closure.
Hub stops the Edge core and records the exact PID, UID, signal/exit result and listener closure.
Hub verifies 127.0.0.1:8080, the selected private Edge delivery address/port, 127.0.0.1:21444 and 127.0.0.1:21445 are closed, the guest is stopped and the shared build lock is absent.
cleanup_and_timeout.retention: Retain the exact versioned host/guest roots as evidence only, with modes and no-secret/no-payload log scans. Never reuse or repair them in place.

required_receipts: proposal hash, source head and critical-file hashes
fresh guest OS/build/architecture/address, root absent-before-create result and listener preflight
Fresh source-bound Edge binary and source-to-binary receipt, plus receiver/helper hashes and target/toolchain identities
exact config, state, spool, bearer, credential and TLS paths with owner/mode/readability metadata, without values
Edge init/doctor, stable health/ready zero-state, receiver status and exact listener ownership
fresh Hub empty control-poll and empty durable ledger/pending/accumulator/frontier receipt
fresh producer identity/helper/client-leaf binding and one invocation receipt
receiver ACK, Edge v2 batch, Hub durable commit, per-sequence disposition, projection count, exact ACK/frontier and post-ACK zero-state receipt
bounded cleanup, exact process results, port closure, guest stop, lock absence and redacted log scan

ownership.edge: Owns this source-bound contract, Edge source/candidate identity, config/schema and encrypted spool/delivery behavior. Edge does not own the shared guest launch or Hub fixture.
ownership.hub: Owns the fresh guest/root, target preflight, runtime-generated PKI/bearers/identities, fixture, process launch, durable commit/ACK evidence and cleanup.
ownership.coordinator: Owns the separate one-shot producer authorization and cross-product acceptance decision.

receiver_readiness_receipt.facts: The exact c2ace receiver owned loopback 21444/21445, status returned HTTP 200 ok, event_count was zero, no Edge process or Hub/HA action occurred, SIGTERM cleanup completed, ports closed, guest stopped and lock absent.
receiver_readiness_receipt.limit: This is receiver startup/status/cleanup evidence only; it does not satisfy Edge forwarding, durable Hub ACK/frontier, HA, service lifecycle or platform acceptance.

historical_forwarding_proposal.use: Historical planning evidence only. Its root, address, listeners, credentials, identities, producer invocation and receipts are not inputs to this contract.
